claim: front [A], coalition {1}: the profile in which exactly these players quit outright is not a Nash equilibrium of the stage game G(c), for ANY continuation vector c. Player 2 is a stayer who strictly gains by quitting: the deviation gain D_2 of src/stage.jl is positive at the profile, while the stage-Nash conditions require it to be at most zero. The two conditions below are that deviation gain and the weight z_2(x) = prod_{j != i} (1 - x_j) with which the continuation enters it. D_i is affine in c_i with coefficient -z_i and involves no other c_j, so z_i = 0 at this profile makes the value a constant and the sign unconditional -- in particular the lone-quitter branch of case T, which needs c in W_0 and hence (R2), is not used here. Coefficients are the payoff entries, so substituting the point is a check about this game (docs/G3_MIXED_APS.md 12.15(b), 12.20).
